opportunities.name: AP challenge duelist
opportunities.objective: Test ap challenge duelist against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Audacious Charge has 1.2 AP magic damage, W thrust adds 0.65 AP physical damage and longer slow, and Crescent Guard has 1.1 AP physical damage. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn support attacks between Q cooldown refunds; Determination's AP healing helpers suggest sustain but exact dispatch remains unresolved.
opportunities.requiredState: Mark with W, enter E and complete real Q attacks.
opportunities.failure: Low AD or attacks interrupted by control lose both damage and refunds.
opportunities.test: Separate E magic, W/R physical and passive healing in a ten-second duel.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP ratios do not turn W/R magic; no verified numeric healing from unresolved conditional helpers.

opportunities.name: Crescent health frontline
opportunities.objective: Test crescent health frontline against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Crescent Guard excludes damage from enemies outside its sweep range for four seconds; health and Bloodmail support surviving the challenged inside opponent. Three Talon Strike lowers other cooldowns on its three actual attacks, while Visage and Sundered Sky help the repeat-contact phase.
opportunities.requiredState: Choose a favorable challenged enemy and keep outside threats beyond R's radius.
opportunities.failure: The challenged melee opponent still deals damage and crowd control can prevent Q hits.
opportunities.test: Compare inside versus outside incoming damage and Q refund count.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Crescent Guard is not complete invulnerability and does not excuse ignoring the duel target.

ruledOut.reason: AP ratios do not turn W/R magic; no verified numeric healing from unresolved conditional helpers.

unknowns: Current-patch proc ordering/effectiveness is untested; symbolic source stats and helper form/pet records are not runtime dispatch proof.

builds.name: AP challenge duelist
builds.summary: Test ap challenge duelist against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test ap challenge duelist against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Audacious Charge has 1.2 AP magic damage, W thrust adds 0.65 AP physical damage and longer slow, and Crescent Guard has 1.1 AP physical damage. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn support attacks between Q cooldown refunds; Determination's AP healing helpers suggest sustain but exact dispatch remains unresolved.
testPlan: Required state: Mark with W, enter E and complete real Q attacks.
Separate E magic, W/R physical and passive healing in a ten-second duel.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low AD or attacks interrupted by control lose both damage and refunds.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP ratios do not turn W/R magic; no verified numeric healing from unresolved conditional helpers.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Hextech Gunblade, Riftmaker, Terminus, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (1.2) × AP] magic damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by [30]% for [0.5] seconds.

Xin Zhao grants himself @f1@% (%i:scaleAS%%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed for [5] seconds.

This Ability's range is increased on enemies that are Challenged.

Xin Zhao slashes, dealing [30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 + (0.3) × AD] physical damage, then thrusts, dealing [(50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + (0.9) × AD + (0.65) × AP) × ((1 + (0.333) × Stat(8)))]. Enemies hit by the thrust are Slowed by [50]% for [1.5 + (0.005) × AP] seconds. 

Champions and Large Monsters hit by the thrust are marked as Challenged for [3] seconds and revealed unless Stealthed.

Passive: The last champion Xin Zhao damaged with an Attack or Audacious Charge is Challenged for [3] seconds.

Active: Xin Zhao unleashes a sweep around him that deals [75 / 175 / 275 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1.1) × AP] plus [15]% current Health physical damage and Knocks Back all non-Challenged enemies. 
  
Afterwards, Xin Zhao becomes immune to damage from enemies outside the sweep range for [4] seconds.

Xin Zhao's next 3 Attacks deal an additional [15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / 75 + (0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and reduces his other Ability's Cooldowns by 1 second. The third Attack also Knocks Up for [0.75] seconds.

Every third Attack or strike with Wind Becomes Lightning deals an additional [(characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.15, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.15000000596046448, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.15000000596046448, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.15000000596046448, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 21, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.15000000596046448, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 26, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.15000000596046448, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])) × AD + (characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.05, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05000000074505806, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05000000074505806, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05000000074505806, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 21, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05000000074505806, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 26, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05000000074505806, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])) × AP] physical damage and restores [(UNRESOLVED({f3cbe7b2}; see calculationRaw)) × Stat(12) + (UNRESOLVED({f3cbe7b2}; see calculationRaw)) × AP] Health.
